A.text: The first ionisation energy of chlorine is more than the first ionisation energy of argon.

B.text: The second ionisation energy of calcium is more than the second ionisation energy of magnesium.

C.text: The second ionisation energy of sulfur is equal to the first ionisation energy of phosphorus.

D.text: The eighth ionisation energy of chlorine is more than the first ionisation energy of neon.
